title: SG-7.8 · Round poller behind a mocked Git interface
summary: Worker polls Rounds through a Git interface, detects SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds, and closes expired Rounds through the snapshot logic
description: Context: backend/worker/internal has config, store, lock, runner, recovery and report packages but no poller. The backend round.Service.Close already writes snapshot.yaml, records FreezeCommit and moves a Round to CLOSED. Desired behavior: a new poller package pulls the repository through a Git interface, lists the Rounds of the World, reports SCHEDULED and CLOSED Rounds, and closes OPEN Rounds whose end time has passed through a Closer interface that mirrors round.Service.Close. Expected result: unit tests with a fake Git, fake Closer and fake clock prove detection, closing and error handling. Why: Phase 5 needs the worker to see closed Rounds and freeze expired ones.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Git fake returning SCHEDULED, OPEN and CLOSED Rounds, when Poll runs, then Result.Scheduled and Result.Closed list the matching Round IDs.
Given an OPEN Round whose EndsAt is not after the clock time, when Poll runs, then Closer.Close is called once for it and its ID is in Result.ClosedNow and Result.Closed.
Given Git pull fails, when Poll runs, then Poll returns a wrapped error and calls neither ListRounds nor Close.
Given Close fails for one Round, when Poll runs, then the other Rounds are still processed and the error is returned.

in_scope: New package backend/worker/internal/poller with Git, Closer and Clock interfaces and Poller.Poll
out_of_scope: Poll loop wiring in a worker main

technical_constraints: Go 1.22 module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/worker; no new third-party dependencies
The poller must not import backend/internal packages; the Closer interface mirrors round.Service.Close(ctx, worldID, roundID) error
definition_of_done: All acceptance criteria are covered by unit tests that pass with go test ./internal/poller
non_functional: Poll is deterministic and uses only the injected clock
